sources.title: Independent nonzero-vector cosine arithmetic
sources.details: For nonzero real vectors u,v, dot(u/||u||2,v/||v||2)=dot(u,v)/(||u||2||v||2)=cos(theta). Positive scaling cancels from numerator/denominator. ||[3,4]||2=sqrt(9+16)=5; [3,4]/5=[0.6,0.8]. [1,1]/sqrt(2) has dot 1/sqrt(2)=0.7071067812 with both [1,0] and [0,1], so total sqrt(2), not 1. Dot with [1,0], [0,1], [-1,0] gives 1,0,-1. Hand vectors have dimensionless direction scores; two candidates are the column denominator only after softmax, not a cosine normalization denominator.

claims.scope: The shown nonzero real vectors; numerical feature coordinates are not physical image left/right. Mathematical cosine and default p=2 F.normalize agree when vector norm exceeds epsilon.
